note: Coris Bank International Côte d'Ivoire's conditions for the first half of 2026 (May 2026): keeping an account costs 5,500 francs a month, taxes included, for a non-salaried private customer, the rate for a customer who isn't salaried, as a performer working by engagement is (3,850 for the salaried).
